config.count_format: author makeCDS.R reads headerless 1-based gene,cell,integer-count triplets; axes supplied by original annotation files
config.culture_provenance: unknown; RT origin and replicate/plate labels do not certify independently initiated cultures
config.hash_table_schema: library,cell,condition,hash-family,count; fourth field matches sample-sheet family 1, fifth field supplies counts; no header in deposited file
config.normalization: full-library cell counts to 10000, condition count means, log2(1+mean), matched literal plate/line controls
config.pair_diagnostic_eligibility: requires a separate >=36 canonical pair contract; dose aliases are not distinct pairs
config.panel_selection: equal-context within-context measured-single variance after equal-stratum aggregation by literal single identity, lexical gene ties; controls/singles only, no pair outcomes
config.partition: original count-column index modulo two; technical cell partitions, no independent culture inference
config.population: all literal nonvehicle chemical-plus-Trametinib identities present in the author sheet, fixed dose/time; unsupported labels retained with reasons
config.purpose: Public chemical star-screen technical measurement-reliability pilot; no prediction nomination or biological confirmation
config.rt_eligibility: author cleanup retains RT wells 1 through 96; other RT origins excluded with explicit counts
config.stopping: One registered measurement pilot; no architecture fitting, threshold relaxation, endpoint/rank sweep, nomination or frontier claim
